==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|stabletee}}, {{m|enm|stabilite}}, from {{der|en|fro|stabilité}}, from {{der|en|la|-}} root of {{m|la|stabilitas||firmness, steadfastness}}, from {{m|la|stabilis||steadfast, firm}}. Displaced native {{ncog|ang|staþolfæstnes}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/stəˈbɪlɪti/|[stəˈbɪlɪɾi]}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-stability.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪlɪti|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The condition of being [[stable]] or in [[equilibrium]], and thus [[resistant]] to [[change]].
#: {{syn|en|stableness}}
#: {{ant|en|instability}}
#: {{ux|en|This platform offers good '''stability'''}}
# The tendency to recover from [[perturbation]]s.
#: {{ux|en|emotional '''stability'''}}
